standard.summary: 开启后可按模块类型（自注意力/交叉注意力/MLP/调制/LLM Adapter）分别设置 LoRA alpha，而不是全局统一。留空的组仍使用上方的全局 Network Alpha。关闭 = 所有组统一 = 传统 LoRA。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Once on, LoRA alpha can be set per module type (self-attention / cross-attention / MLP / modulation / LLM adapter) instead of one value everywhere. Groups left blank still use the global Network Alpha above. Off = every group the same = conventional LoRA.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 开启后可按模块类型（自注意力/交叉注意力/MLP/调制/LLM Adapter）分别设置 LoRA alpha，而不是全局统一。留空的组仍使用上方的全局 Network Alpha。关闭 = 所有组统一 = 传统 LoRA。

advanced_en.principle: When on, LoRA alpha can be set separately per module type (self-attention / cross-attention / MLP / modulation / LLM Adapter) instead of one global value. Groups left empty still use the global Network Alpha above. Off = all groups unified = traditional LoRA.
